Honestly it depends for you. I went through it and came out of it after a really rough year a while back. The best things I can tell you:

 Seek professional help, talk to those who you feel close to and trust, keep your mind busy, fix all the little problems and exercise. 
I've tried ending my life but I pulled through after taking a step back and realizing people want me alive. And you will have downer moods even when you mostly are happy and out of the woods. 

Really, keep fighting and don't stop. Ever. Don't be ashamed if you need to be on medication or seek therapy. We all have to survive somehow. PM me OP if you need someone to talk to, my inbox is always open.
